name: forever-route-lab
description: Route planner, simulator, validator, RXP editor and optimisation workbench for World of Warcraft: Forever. Static site, no backend.

scripts.build: vite build && tsx tools/build/licence-gate.ts && tsx tools/build/third-party-notices.ts && tsx tools/build/audit-dist.ts --strip-manifest
scripts.build:deploy: tsx tools/build/minimap-fetch.ts && vite build --mode deploy && tsx tools/build/licence-gate.ts && tsx tools/build/third-party-notices.ts && tsx tools/build/audit-dist.ts --strip-manifest --deploy
scripts.build:painted: vite build --mode painted && tsx tools/build/licence-gate.ts && tsx tools/build/third-party-notices.ts && tsx tools/build/audit-dist.ts --strip-manifest
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.pure.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.app.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.node.json
scripts.data:all: pnpm data:fetch && pnpm data:extract && pnpm data:validate
scripts.data:check: pnpm data:fetch && pnpm data:extract --check && pnpm data:validate
scripts.check: pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint && pnpm test && pnpm data:validate && pnpm build
